decisions.reason: Responsive guidance for website pages is a separate item in the source message; expanding console-shell design coverage to the dashboard canvas does not change this Requirement.
The visual foundation for follow-on website pages is separately specified and remains unchanged by the dashboard shell and canvas design decision.
Responsive behavior for the original landing page is an independent source-message item and is not altered by the console-shell coverage expansion.
The dashboard reference in the How It Works copy is descriptive content; dashboard shell and canvas styling does not change the section's position, presentation, or steps.
The landing-page visual system and the dashboard shell visual design are distinct contexts, and the source decision does not necessarily modify the landing-page theme or styling attributes.
Dashboard shell and canvas styling has no necessary effect on whether previously supplied follow-on copy is included on the landing page.
The dashboard shell design coverage does not change the landing-page sign-up button's action or control type.
